Title: Internal Rectangle Tool
Content: Objective Create a rectangle inside a Pattern. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Rectangle 2D Toolbar Internal Rectangle Operation Create Internal Rectangle Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Rectangle 2D Toolbar Internal Rectangle Click and drag within a Pattern to freehand an Internal Rectangle. Release the mouse to complete the Internal Rectangle. Note: While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Shift key on the keyboard to create a square (ver.5.1.0). While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create it by the center point (ver.5.1.0). While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Shift + Ctrl keys to create a square Internal Shape by its center point (ver.5.1.0). Create Internal Rectangle with Measurement Input Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Rectangle 2D Toolbar Internal Rectangle Click once within a Pattern. The Create Rectangle window appears. Enter appropriate values in the options indicated below. Width Set width of an Internal Rectangle. Height Set height of an Internal Rectangle. Link width and height to adjust them in a fixed ratio. Position Outline Set left, right, top and bottom position of an internal rectangle on the basis of the outline of the Internal Rectangle (ver2.5.0). Center Set left, right, top and bottom position of an internal rectangle on the basis of the center of the Internal Rectangle (ver2.5.0). Note: Internal Shape Tool Group

Title: Flip Graphic Image Horizontally/Vertically
Content: Objective Flip graphic images horizontally or vertically (only available in the 2D window). Location 2D Toolbar Transform Graphic Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Flip Horizontally / Flip Vertically Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar Transform Graphic Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Flip Horizontally / Flip Vertically The selected graphic image is now being flipped accordingly.

Title: Graphic Configuration
Content: Objective Configure graphics to repeat along the x-axis, y-axis, or all over the pattern. Use this function when graphics are used repeatedly on a Garment. Location Via the Property Editor Main Menu Materials Graphics Graphic (2D Pattern) or Graphic (3D Pattern) 2D Toolbar or 3D Toolbar Graphic (2D Pattern) or Graphic (3D Pattern) Via the Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Main Menu Materials Graphics Transform Graphic Right-Click (on Graphic) 2D Toolbar or 3D Toolbar Transform Graphic Right-Click (on Graphic) Operation Via the Property Editor Follow the path: Main Menu Materials Graphics Graphic (2D Pattern) or Graphic (3D Pattern) 2D Toolbar or 3D Toolbar Graphic (2D Pattern) or Graphic (3D Pattern) The properties of the selected graphic will appear in the Property Editor. Find the Tile menu in the Property Editor and adjust the settings below as needed: Option Description Revert to Original Reset the graphic to its original configuration before this function was used. X-Axis Repeat the graphic along the x-axis of the pattern, while maintaining its dimensions. Y-Axis Repeat the graphic along the y-axis of the pattern, while maintaining its dimensions. Pattern Repeat the graphic across the entire pattern, while maintaining its dimensions. The selected graphic will be tiled according to the menu selection. Via the Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Follow the path: Main Menu Materials Graphics Transform Graphic Right-Click (on Graphic) 2D Toolbar or 3D Toolbar Transform Graphic Right-Click (on Graphic) Right-click pop-up menu appears. Navigate to Tile and select from the available options (same as Property Editor). The selected graphic will be tiled according to the menu selection. Note: When a graphic is repeated using this function, its Graphic Transformation Original Width and Original Height values will change.

Title: Apply Normal Map To Graphic Image
Content: Objective Apply Normal Maps to graphics for more realistic visualization. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic 2D Toolbar Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic 2D Toolbar Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic Select a graphic image to apply Normal Map. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. Material Texture Normal Map The intensity value range of -10 to 10 can be applied automatically as entered. The higher the value, the bumpier expression, the less the value, the less bumpier expression.

Title: Create 2D Graphic Measurement
Content: Objective View graphic position from the Pattern outline with 2D measurements. (ver2.5.0) Location Graphics Property Editor 2D Measurement Operation 2D Toolbar Select a graphic with Transform Graphic. Follow the indicated guideline below: Graphics Property Editor 2D Measurement Select the desired 2D measurement option. To Center View the 2D measurements from the center of the graphic to left/right/top/bottom of the Pattern outline. To Outline View the 2D measurements from the left/right/top/bottom of the graphic to the Pattern outline. The 2D measurements are now being displayed accordingly.

Title: Copy/Duplicate Graphic Image
Content: Objective Copy/paste or duplicate graphic images as needed. Location Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Copy (Ctrl + C), Paste (Ctrl + V) / Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern Operation Copy/Paste Graphic Image Select a graphic image with Edit Texture tool or Transform Graphic tool in the 2D window. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Copy (Ctrl + C), Paste (Ctrl + V) The copied graphic image is now being followed on the mouse. Place the copied graphic image at a desired location in the 2D window. Duplicate Graphic Image (ver2.3.0) Select a graphic image with Edit Texture tool or Transform Graphic tool in the 2D window. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern The selected graphic image is now being duplicated to Symmetric Pattern. Note: Duplicate Graphic Image can only be used on Symmetrical Patterns.

Title: Show/Hide Piping
Content: Objective Show or hide all Piping. Location 3D Window Garment Show/Hide Icon (Mouse Over) Show Piping Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Window Garment Show/Hide Icon (Mouse Over) Show Piping All created Piping is now being hidden. Follow the indicated guideline again: 3D Window Garment Show/Hide Icon (Mouse Over) Show Piping All hidden Piping is now being displayed again.

Title: Piping Property Setting
Content: Objective Modify the physical Piping properties at Property Editor. Location Property Editor Explanation Piping properties appear in the Property Editor when a Piping is selected with the Select/Move tool or the Edit Piping tool. Piping Property Definition Name Renames selected Piping. Line Length Displays the line length of selected Piping. Width (mm) Adjusts the width of selected Piping between the value of 1~15mm. Particle Distance (mm) Adjusts the Particle Distance of selected Piping between the value of 1~5mm. Hide Shows/hides selected Piping. (Select a Piping from the Scene tab in the Object Browser to reveal menu.) Fabric Applies fabric settings to selected Piping from the drop-down item list of Fabric. Piping's fabric texture can be edited using the edit_texture.png Edit Texture tool (ver4.2.0).

Title: ZIPPER: Zipper/Slider Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
Content: Objective Modify the Zipper or Slider via the right-click pop-up menu. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Right-Click on a Zipper or Slider Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move Right-Click on a Zipper or Slider The respective pop-up menu appears for the Zipper or Slider. Adjust the settings below as needed: Zipper Tape Slider Delete Delete the selected Zipper and Zipper Slider. Deactivate Deactivate or activate the selected Zipper and Slider. Freeze Freeze or unfreeze the selected Zipper and Slider. Reverse (Right-Clicked Teeth) Reverse the sewing direction of the Zipper Tape based on the side of the Zipper Tape that was right clicked. n/a Flip Normal (Right-Clicked Teeth) Flip the surface of the side of the Zipper Tape that was right clicked. n/a Reset Slider Arrangement n/a Reset the slider's position and angle to default (ver4.1.0). Show/Hide Slider n/a Show or hide the Slider (ver4.0.0).

Title: ZIPPER: Slider Gizmo
Content: Objective Move or rotate the slider to adjust its distance from the zipper tape. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Operation Move Create a zipper. While the Simulation is turned off, follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Click the slider. The slider is selected and its Gizmo appears. Click and drag the blue segment of the Gizmo to move the slider back and forth. Sliders cannot be moved along with Y and Z axes. Rotate With the Select/Move tool, click on the slider to access the Slider Gizmo. Click and drag the blue circle of the Gizmo to rotate on the Y axis. Click and drag the yellow-green circle of the Gizmo to rotate on the X axis. Click and drag the red circle of the Gizmo to rotate on the Z axis. The selected zipper slider rotates based on the selected circle. To rotate the puller only, click on the puller while the slider is selected. The selected puller is highlighted in yellow and the Gizmo changes accordingly. Rotate the puller referencing #2. Note: To reset the slider's position and angle, right click on the slider and select the Reset Slider Arrangement option.

Title: ZIPPER: Zipper Tape Properties
Content: Objective Modify the Zipper tape properties. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape) Property Editor Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape) Property Editor The properties of the selected Zipper Tape appear in the Property Editor. Modify the Zipper Tape properties based on the available options below: Properties Description Name Rename the Zipper Tape. Line Length Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Size (ver.11) Set the size of the Zipper. Teeth Width Enter directly the width of the Zipper to adjust. Total Width Adjust the Tape width of the Zipper. Width Set the width of the Zipper Tape. The texture image changes based on the width entered. Thickness Set the Zipper Tape Thickness. Particle Distance Adjust zipper tape's Particle Distance. Fasten Zipper Zip or unzip the Zipper. Fold Adjust the Strength of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. Material Set the Material Type, Texture, Color and Opacity of the Zipper Teeth and Tape. Physical Property Adjust physical properties to the selected zipper teeth.

Title: OBJ TRIM: Set OBJ Trim Weight
Content: Objective When an OBJ is imported as a Garment, input weight and reflect in the Simulation. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move(Q) 3D Toolbar Select/Move(Q) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Select the loaded OBJ trim. The OBJ properties display in Property Editor. Enter desired value at Simulation Properties Weight, and simulate. The value is now being applied and simulated accordingly.

Title: OBJ TRIM: Copy/Paste Trims
Content: Objective Copy and paste trims in the 3D window. Location Copy Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Copy Paste Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Paste Operation Load an OBJ as a Trim. Select the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar. To copy a trim, follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Copy The selected trim is copied. To paste the copied trim, follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Paste Click to place the duplicated trim in the 3D window. The trim is pasted. Note: To copy and paste multiple trims, hold down Shift on the keyboard and select all trims to be copied, then perform the procedure above. When copying and pasting multiple trims, they must all be placed within a Pattern. Shortcuts for copy and paste are Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V respectively.

Title: OBJ TRIM: Glue OBJ Trim
Content: Objective Glue 3D Trims onto Garments and simulate together (ver3.0.0). Location Main Menu File Import OBJ Operation Glue OBJ Trim Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Import OBJ Open File window appears. Select desired OBJ file and click OK to load. In the pop-up menu, select Load as Trim for the Object Type, and click OK. Click the loaded OBJ with the Select/Move tool. Gizmo for the selected OBJ appears. Click on the Glue icon next to the OBJ Gizmo, then mouse over the desired location. OBJ preview tags along the mouse. Click on the desired location. Selected OBJ automatically attaches to the place. Use the Gizmo to adjust the position and angle. Note: To cancel the arrangement, press Esc on the keyboard. Activate Simulation. OBJ is now being simulated along with the rest of the Garments. Note: You can select multiple OBJ trims and move or rotate those by using Gizmo. (ver. 11 ) Delete OBJ Trim Right click on the OBJ trim. OBJ is now being selected and a pop-up menu appears. Note: Relevant menu above does not appear for OBJ trims that are not glued to the Garments. Click on Delete to remove it. Selected OBJ is now being removed from the Garments.

Title: Edit 3D Garment Measure
Content: Objective Edit 3D Garment Measure. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Edit Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Edit Garment Measure Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Edit Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Edit Garment Measure Click on a 3D Garment Measure to edit. The selected 3D Garment Measure is now being highlighted. Its properties are now being appeared in the Property Editor. Modify the properties of 3D Garment Measure. Linear Garment Measure Circumference Garment Measure Name Rename the Linear Garment Measure. Name Rename the Circumference Garment Measure. Length Confirm the length of the Linear Garment Measure. Surface Length Confirm the length of the Circumference Garment Measure. Square Width Modify the width of the square that appears at the end of the Linear Garment Measure. Circle Diameter Modify the circle diameter that appears with the Circumference Garment Measure.

Title: Create 3D Garment Measure
Content: Objective Measure 3D Garment height and circumference. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Linear/Circumference Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Linear Garment Measure / Circumference Garment Measure Operation Linear Garment Measure Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Linear Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Linear Garment Measure Click the beginning point of the Linear Garment Measure on a 3D Garment once. A green dot and rectangle appear. While pressing Shift on the keyboard, click the endpoint of the measurement. A vertical measurement with its length is now being created and displayed. Circumference Garment Measure Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Circumference Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Circumference Garment Measure Click on an area to measure its circumference. A circumference measurement with its value is now being created and displayed.

Title: Flattening as Straight Line
Content: Objective Maintain a particular Line (Avatar) straight when flattening a Pattern. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Edit Line (Avatar) 3D Toolbar Edit Line (Avatar) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Edit Line (Avatar) 3D Toolbar Edit Line (Avatar) When the Avatar is draped, its Garment becomes translucent. Right click on the Line (Avatar) to be flattened as a center front/back or a straight line. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Flattening as a Straight Line. The selected line is bolded. The selected line flattens straight.

Title: Trace as / Convert to Internal Shape
Content: Objective Use the Trace function to convert selected lines/shapes or areas into Internal Lines/Shapes. Location 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Click on created Baselines or Internal Lines on 3D Garment. The selected Baselines or Internal Lines are now highlighted in yellow. Right-click on the selected Baselines or Internal Lines. A Pop-up menu appears. Select Trace as Internal Shape or Convert to Internal Shape in the pop-up menu. The selected Baselines or Internal Lines are now being traced as /converted to Internal Shapes.

Title: Delete Chalk
Content: Objective Delete Baselines created on Garments. Note: The chalk function has been replaced with Line (3D Pattern) from ver3.0.0. Location 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Click on a Baseline to delete. The selected Baseline is now being highlighted in yellow color. Press Delete on the keyboard. The selected Baseline is now being deleted. Note: Press Ctrl + A on the keyboard to select all Baselines.

Title: Line Tack on Garment
Content: Objective Create lines on Garment and tack to each other by lines / shapes. (Ver. MD7) Location 3D window tool bar Line tack tool Operation Select the tool according to the Location above. Mouse over to a garment from 3D window. Point follows mouse cursor. Double click on the garment where want to create start point of line / shape. Double click to complete the line / shape Double click on start point of line to create closed shape. Create second line/ shape. Once all the two lines / shapes have been created, connection line for line / shape will be displayed. Click the simulation button. Two lines/ shapes tack to each other along the connection line. During the creation of the line, pressing the Shift key will display the front, back, side center line and guide line of last point. Press the Ctrl key to create curved line. When creating a line, can cancel it from the last point by pressing the Delete key on Keyboard. Press the Esc / Ctrl+Z to cancel the whole point.

Title: Copy/Paste Tack
Content: Objective Copy and paste tack. Location Main Menu Sewing Tack Edit Tack 3D Toolbar Edit Tack Operation Copy/Paste Tack Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Tack Edit Tack 3D Toolbar Edit Tack The Garment becomes translucent. Right click on the tack to be copied and pasted. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Copy The selected tack is copied. Access the right-click pop-up menu again on the copied tack. Select Paste or Mirror Paste. Preview of the selected tack follows the mouse cursor in 2D and 3D windows. Any tack outside of the Pattern does not appear in the 3D window. Click the desired location to paste the tack. Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Tack Edit Tack 3D Toolbar Edit Tack The Garment becomes translucent. Right click on the tack to be duplicated to Symmetric Pattern. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern. Selected tack is duplicated to the exact same location on its Symmetric Pattern. Note: Selected tacks need to be within the same Pattern in order to be duplicated to their Symmetric Patterns.

Title: Express Air Pressure
Content: Objective Use the Pressure value to create an effect of air or padded materials such as padded jumpers, pillows, cushions, balloons, etc. Location Click Pattern Property Editor Simulation Properties Pressure Operation Select a Pattern to express pressure with Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern tools. Its properties appear in Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Simulation Properties Pressure Adjust the value as desired.

Title: Binding (ver. 11)
Content: Create Binding Objective Easily create Binding along Pattern Outlines. Location Main Menu Materials Binding Binding 3D Toolbar Binding Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. Pattern Outlines and Internal Lines where Binding can be created appear in dashed lines. 2. On a 3D Garment or 2D Pattern, click the start point and double click where you want to finish the Binding. Binding is created on the selected segment. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. Select Binding Objective Edit Binding Properties. Location Main Menu Materials Binding Select Binding 3D Toolbar Select Binding Note: 3D toolbar Select bindings with the Select/Move tool. Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. The line segment for which the binding was created is displayed. 2. Select the Binding to be edited. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Configure each property as needed referring to below table. Option Description Name Rename Binding's name. Line Length Check Binding's length. However, it cannot be changed from the Property Editor. Type Under Bindings are placed under the Patterns to express Inside Bindings. Over Bindings are placed over the Patterns. Both Bindings are placed both direction of the Patterns. Dimension Width Adjust selected Binding's width. (1~50mm) Length Adjust selected Binding's length with percentage (50% ~ 200%) or a specific value. Particle Distance Edit selected Binding's Particle Distance (4~20mm) Add'l Thickness - Collision Adjust Binding's Add'l Thickness - Collision. Fabric Assign Fabric to the Binding. Fabric styles in the Fabric Object Browser appear in a list. Grain Direction Bias/ Warp/ Custom Choose among Bias, Warp, or Custom for the Binding's grain direction. Angle Manually insert Angle value to set the Binding's grain direction. Topstitch Add Topstitch to the Binding. The Topstitch option shows the styles which are added in the Topstitch tab of Object Browser. Sewing Line Type Edit Binding's Sewing Line Type. Extend Set whether to extend the binding after creating it on a part of the line segment. Note: Binding Extension is not possible in the following cases. When the angle of both segments are more than 180 degrees based on the binding start/end point. 4. Right-click on the Binding to be edited. Option Description Delete Delete selected Binding. Reset Arrangement Reset Binding's position. Use this option to fix unstable simulations. Deactivate / Activate Deactivate or activate selected Binding. Freeze / Unfreeze Freeze or unfreeze selected Binding. Flip Normal The selected Binding's face flips to the other side.

Title: Apply Substance SBSAR Materials to Trims, Buttons, and Avatars
Content: Objective Allows the user to apply high-quality Substance materials to assets other than cloth patterns within Marvelous Designer. Location Fabric Property Editor Material Substance Operation Load garment and avatar. Add trim or button to garment. Select the Fabric viewer in a window dropdown menu. In the Property Editor for a selected fabric, set the Material to 'Substance'. Click on the four-square button next to the Substance logo and import a Substance (.sbsar) file. Click on any Trim, Button, or part of the Avatar. Navigate to the Fabric window, select the Fabric the Substance material is assigned to, then select 'Assign' at the top of the Fabric window. Observe that the Substance material has been applied to the Trim, Button, or Avatar component.

Title: Emission Color Setting (BELOW VER3.2.0)
Content: Objective Adjust Emission Color to express self-illuminated materials such as luminous or retro-reflective. Location Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Emission Color Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Emission Color Click on the color-palette and adjust the value as desired. Note: Color Palette Eyedropper tool allows extraction of any desired color not only from Marvelous Designer but any other websites or images.

Title: Specular Color/Map Setting (BELOW VER3.2.0)
Content: Objective Specular color is the color of highlights on a shiny surface. The highlights are reflections of the lights that illuminate the surface. Adjust this setting to express glossy fabrics such as leather and enamel, and apply textures to create variations. Location Specular Color Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Specular Color Specular Map Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Specular Map Operation Specular Color Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Specular Color Click on the color palette then adjust the value as desired. Note: Use the Eyedropper to extract colors from within the program as well as from websites or images. Specular Map Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Specular Map Click on the Open icon located in the right corner. Load a texture image file. Texture is now applied to the highlights of the Fabric. Note: The specular map is invisible as long as the default specular color (black) is applied. Resize the specular map image by entering specific values in the location below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Texture Transformation Drag and drop an image file directly from the file browser to the Open icon next to the Specular Map menu in the Property Editor (ver4.0.0). Drag and drop an image file directly from the file browser to an object in the program, then select the correct map: texture, normal, specular (ver4.0.0).

Title: Shininess Setting (BELOW VER3.2.0)
Content: Objective Shininess is used with Specular Color. Adjust it to adjust the area where light reflects on Garments. Location Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Triangle ahead of Specular Color Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Triangle ahead of Specular Color Move the Shininess scroll-bar to adjust. Increasing the value with the scroll-bar expresses shinier Garment gloss similar to enamel or metal, on the other hand decreasing the value expresses more wide-spreading Garment gloss such as lamé.

Title: Material Type (VER4.0.0)
Content: Objective fabric gloss and hardware material can be adjusted with Type setting in the Property Editor. Location Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Type Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Fabric Property Editor Material Type Refer to the table below to adjust fabric gloss and hardware material. Name Description Type Choose the reflection type to express fabric gloss more realistically as needed. Fabric_Matte Reflection is adjusted optimal to express general fabric. Fabric_Shiny Reflection is adjusted optimal to express shiny fabric. Fabric_Silk/Satin Reflection is adjusted optimal to express silk or satin fabric. (ver4.1.0) Fabric_Velvet Reflection is adjusted optimal to express velvet fabric. (ver4.1.0) Glass (Render Only) Reflection is adjusted optimal to express glass materials. (ver4.1.0) Adjust the opacity with the Absorption value. Lower the value is, more transparent the object is. The Absorption value is relative to the object's thickness. Thicker the object is, lower the Absorption value should be. Leather Reflection is adjusted optimal to express leathers. Metal Reflection is adjusted optimal to express metallic materials. Plastic Reflection is adjusted optimal to express plastics. Roughness Intensity Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness. Map Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity Adjust the Map's Intensity. Invert Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in CLO below ver4.0.0, check this option. Reflection Intensity Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective the material or fabric is and vice-versa.

Title: Open/Save Color Palette File
Content: Objective Open a color palette file (*.ace / *.ase), or save colors as a palette file (*.aco). Location Property Editor Material Color Operation Open Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Color The Color Palette window appears. Click on Open Palette icon on the left side of the palette window. The Open File window appears. Select a desired palette file (*.ace / *.ase) and click Open to load. The selected palette file is now being loaded and applied. Save Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Color The Color Palette window appears. Click on Save as Palette icon on the left side of the palette window. The selected color is now being saved as *.aco file format.

Title: Edit Color Swatch
Content: Objective Rename, reorder, and reset color swatches and color palettes. Location Property Editor Material Color Operation Rename Color Swatch Select a desired object Avatar/Fabric/Button/Topstitch/Etc. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Color The color palette window appears. On the bottom-left side of the palette window, click on a color swatch to be renamed. 'Color Swatch Name' window appears. Rename as desired then either click on somewhere else or press Enter on the keyboard. The selected color swatch's name is now being adjusted. Note: Added Method in ver4.2.0 Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Materials Color The Color window appears. Under the Default_Palette, double click a color swatch to change its name. The Color Swatch Name window appears. Type in the desired name and click OK. Selected swatch's name is changed. Added Method in ver3.2.0 Select an item (Avatar, Fabric, Button, Topstitch, etc.) to change its color. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Color/ Specular Color/ Emission Color Click on the color swatch on the left. Type in the desired name when the name field is activated. Type in the desired name. The selected color swatch's name is changed. Reorder Color Swatch Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Color Click and drag color swatches to reorder as desired. Reset Custom Palette Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Color The Color Palette window appears. Click x on the Default_Palette button on the top of the Palette Library. All default colors are now being deleted.
